input.transcript: Climate change is not only an environmental issue, it is a security issue. First, rising seas threaten coastal cities and naval bases such as Mumbai and Chennai. Second, droughts and floods push people to migrate, which strains resources and can cause unrest. Third, the armed forces are increasingly used in disaster relief, as in the Kerala floods, so training and equipment must adapt. India has responded through the National Action Plan and solar targets. To conclude, we must treat climate preparedness as part of defence planning.

input.topic: Importance of sports in nation building
input.transcript: Sport builds the qualities a nation needs. It teaches discipline, teamwork and the acceptance of defeat. Look at how our hockey and cricket victories united the country, and how Neeraj Chopra inspired young people in small towns. Sport also improves health and lowers the burden on hospitals. It gives rural youth a path out of poverty through schemes like Khelo India. For the armed forces, sport is the training ground of stamina and leadership. So investing in sport is investing in the nation.

Cyber warfare means attacks on computer systems. Countries attack power grids and banks. India must protect its networks and train experts. The armed forces have a cyber agency. People should use strong passwords. In conclusion cyber security is important for our country.
